_about: Index -> name of the EMBER2024 family/tag model outputs, RECONSTRUCTED by DocuTraceX (the authors did not publish the label maps). Matched on 67,806 labelled EMBER2024 test files: tag outputs by ROC AUC against each tag (mutual best match), family outputs by majority vote of each family's files. confidence: high = AUC>=0.90 / agreement & purity>=0.5; medium = AUC 0.75-0.90 / agreement>=0.3. Outputs without a name are not shown.
